title: Love and Patience
truth: God helps us to be kind and patient with others because He first loved us with perfect patience.
points: Jesus shows us how to be truly humble.
He was gentle even when people were mean.
He patiently loves us every single day.
apply: Today, try to be extra patient with someone in your family or at school. Remember how Jesus is patient with you.
prayer: God, thank You for loving me with so much patience. Help me to show that same love to others today.
